basics.name: Codie Freeman
basics.summary: Final-year Pharmaceutical Chemistry student graduating June 2027, with a year of GMP placement experience in pharmaceutical solid-state characterisation at a contract research organisation. Comfortable across method design, instrument work and sponsor reporting, with a growing focus on computational approaches to analytical data.

work.name: Resolian
work.summary: Industrial placement within a GMP-compliant analytical laboratory supporting R&D and regulated client projects.
highlights: Project Delivery: Contributed to over 20 analytical projects, as lead analyst and report author on three multiple time-point stability studies, presenting conclusions for a technically varied sponsor audience.

Data Integrity & Documentation: Maintained GMP laboratory notebooks, ADF records and audit trails to ALCOA++ standard, defending analytical decisions and conclusions under QA and technical adviser review.

Process Improvement: Extended microscopy beyond existing SOP scope using underused functions, replacing a four-step manual composition with a single composite-image workflow, and trained three analysts on it.
Method Development: Designed an iGC-SEA flow-rate case study demonstrating up to 50% reduction in run time for larger probes, extending the laboratory's varied-flow-rate capability.
Data Analysis: Recovered Dorris-Gray and Della Volpe surface energy parameters inaccessible through vendor software, processing raw instrument exports in Python and cross-checking outputs.
Technical Enquiries: Assessed instrument capability against sponsor and internal queries, using literature and vendor documentation to determine whether requested analyses were feasible in-house.

projects.name: Surface Energy of Sucrose at Modified Particle Sizes
projects.summary: Characterised surface energy heterogeneity across three sucrose fractions produced by two processing routes, using iGC-SEA with Dorris-Gray and Peak COM analysis, alongside PXRD, SEM and BET surface area.
highlights: Found that processing route governs surface energy character more strongly than particle size alone, with no direct relationship between BET specific surface area and surface energy, contrary to the expected trend.
Presented at the Analytical Research Forum 2026 and subsequently adopted as a Resolian marketing resource.

projects.name: iGC-SEA Python Package
projects.summary: Developing a Python package for post-processing SMS-IGC-SEA surface energy CSV export data.
highlights: Multi-table CSV parsing, with reproducible surface energy and acid-base calculations.
Provides more detailed analysis and customisation than proprietary software for developed modes.
